summary: Operator site live; 'Book Now' goes to its own Park With Us engine selling single nights on 29 of 52 RV sites. Confirmed fees $40 (re-sourced) and hookups water/sewer, electric now 50; confirmed 77 sites, Wi-Fi, booking; added showers, laundry, max rig 57 ft, engine URL; Good Sam (10%) and military (5%) now sourced to the engine. Phone 864-616-2018 is the one the operator posts. Note cleaned of site count and rates.
flags: Gate facts (private): posted $40/night (2026 pricing page, utilities included); Good Sam 10% on the engine ($36); nearest gateway none within 40 km (gateways.py: Congaree NP 127 km); no trip references. Passes the $50 gate. Presence: own website with phone plus a live booking engine.

Long-stay / workforce: the operator targets 'traveling nurses, construction workers, seasonal snowbirds' and names Plant Vogtle 12 minutes away; rules speak of 'residents' and stays 'depending on the arrangement approved by management'. Five tests: (1) $40 passes; (2) nightly rate on its own site and the engine sells one night with no application; (3) no minimum over 1 night; (4) 29 of 52 engine RV sites bookable nightly (well over 1 in 10); (5) no homes or lots for sale. Passes - keep (AWH accepted nightly 2026-10-01).
Phone 864-616-2018 is a South Carolina area code but is the number on every dogwoodrv.com page and on the engine - it is the operator's.
